dataStorage.title: Data Storage Notice
dataStorage.body:
All work data entered in this app is stored locally on your device.

Your records stay on this phone or tablet. They are not uploaded to a cloud server by this app.

Please read this notice carefully. You must acknowledge both statements below to continue.
dataStorage.privacyBody:
Ward Vikas is an offline-first application.

• All work records, tender details and uploaded documents are stored locally on your device.

• Your data is not uploaded to a public cloud server by this application.

• Only minimal information, such as your mobile number and activation details, may be used to validate your subscription.

• You are responsible for creating regular backups of your data. If your device is lost, damaged, or reset without a backup, your records may not be recoverable.

• By continuing, you acknowledge that you understand how your data is stored and managed within the application.
dataStorage.termsBody:
By using Ward Vikas, you agree to the following:

• The application is licensed only for the active subscription period.

• You are responsible for the accuracy of all work and tender information entered into the application.

• Reverse engineering, unauthorized copying, redistribution, or misuse of the application is prohibited.

• Euspace Technologies is not responsible for decisions made using incorrect or incomplete data entered by users.

• Continued use of the application indicates your acceptance of these Terms & Conditions.
